tone_statements.citation: 赵先进 Zhao Xianjin. 2021. 丘北浪砚壮语音系分析 [Phonological analysis of Langyan Zhuang, Qiubei]. 文山学院学报 2021(2); and Zhao Xianjin. 2021. 文山壮语丘北土语浪砚话塞擦音研究. MA thesis, 云南民族大学.
tone_statements.quote: 丘北浪砚壮语属于壮语北部方言中的丘北土语。在田野调查的基础上研究,初步得出结论:丘北浪砚壮语有27个声母,没有送气音、复辅音声母;韵母共记有86个,有7个单元音韵母,79个复合韵母,且7个单元音韵母做韵母时都读为长音;共有8个声调,1-6调为舒声调,7、8调为促声调,且第7调的长调和第8调的长调都表现出塞声韵尾k尾的脱落,并归在舒声调中。
tone_statements.translation: Langyan Zhuang of Qiubei belongs to the Qiubei vernacular of the Northern dialect of Zhuang. On the basis of fieldwork the preliminary conclusions are: Langyan Zhuang has 27 initials, with no aspirated or cluster initials; 86 finals, 7 monophthongal and 79 compound, the 7 monophthongs all read long when they form a final by themselves; there are 8 tones in all, tones 1-6 being smooth-syllable tones and tones 7 and 8 checked tones, and the long variants of tone 7 and of tone 8 both show loss of the stop coda -k and have merged into the smooth-syllable tones.
tone_statements.locator: author's abstract (摘要) on the 文山学院学报 journal-portal record page for 2021(2): 72-75
tone_statements.n_tones: 8 (1-6 smooth + 7, 8 checked; long 7/8 merging into smooth tones after -k loss)

tone_statements.citation: 杨桂丽 Yang Guili. 2020. 丘北曰者壮语声韵调分析 [Initials, finals and tones of Yuezhe Zhuang of Qiubei]. 文山学院学报 2020(1): 106-111, 116.
tone_statements.quote: 以北部壮语丘北土语曰者话为语言点,作语言调查录音记音。系统包括8个声调,22+个塞音、擦音、鼻音等声母和由主要元音及其与元、辅音韵尾组合成复合韵母的68个韵母。 [...] 声调中有6个舒声调和2个促声调,促声调以塞音韵尾为标记,分成7长短调和8长短调,长短调值相同。
tone_statements.translation: Taking the Yuezhe speech of the Qiubei vernacular of Northern Zhuang as the survey point, recordings and transcriptions were made. The system comprises 8 tones, 22+ initials (stops, fricatives, nasals etc.) and 68 finals formed from the main vowels alone or combined with vowel and consonant codas. [...] Among the tones there are 6 smooth-syllable tones and 2 checked tones; the checked tones are marked by a stop coda and divide into tone 7 long/short and tone 8 long/short, the long and short variants having the same tone values.
tone_statements.locator: author's abstract (摘要) as published on the 文山学院学报 journal-portal record page for 2020(1): 106-111+116
tone_statements.n_tones: 8 (tones 1-6 on smooth syllables + checked 7 and 8, each with long/short varian…

sources.note: Bibliographic survey: lists the four Qiubei phonology writings (Yang 2020, Zhao 2021 article + MA thesis, Zhang Ya 2021, Yang 2024) and states that Zhuang research on 连读变调、语调模式、重音、节奏等超音段特征 is 极其匮乏 (extremely scarce). No Qiubei stress statement.

sources.citation: 陆天桥 Lu Tianqiao (ed.). 壮语方言土语音频数据库 [Audio database of Zhuang dialects], 丘北土语 sub-database (phonology, wordlist, sentences, text), maonan.org, under construction (dated 2024)
sources.note: Primary data: 20 initials, finals, tones 1-6 (22 55 35 33 13 21) + 7a/7b/8a/8b checked tones with example words; 50-item wordlist, 10 sentences, one narrative; every syllable carries a full tone number, no reduced or unmarked syllables, no prose on stress. Silent.

sources.citation: Johnson, Eric C. 2010. A Sociolinguistic Introduction to the Central Taic Languages of Wenshan Prefecture, China. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2010-027. 114 pp.
sources.note: Sociolinguistic survey; Qiubei Yei Zhuang classified as Northern Taic (80% of Qiubei county Zhuang), lexical-similarity and RTT figures only; a full-text search for stress/accent/unstressed/prominence = 0. Silent.

sources.citation: Pittayaporn, Pittayawat. 2009. The Phonology of Proto-Tai. PhD dissertation, Cornell University.
sources.note: Comparative; a 'Qiubei' data point (from Zhang et al. 1999) appears in onset/rime reflex tables (PT *ɓ>b, *ˀj>dʑ, *r>ð, *w kept as w, *ɤ:C>a:C); nothing on stress in Qiubei or any modern Zhuang variety. Silent.
